378	def _min_common_string(t1, t2):
379	    """Shortest string matching both tokenized patterns; ties broken by
380	    Unicode code-point lexicographic order.
381	
382	    Mirrors :func:`_patterns_overlap` over the same token grid, but each
383	    reachable state stores the minimum witness suffix as a ``(length,
384	    text)`` pair (compared by length first, then text) instead of a mere
385	    boolean: a `*` may match the empty string, skip itself, or absorb one
386	    character demanded by a char token on the other side. A star/star
387	    alignment never needs to emit a character. Returns None only when the
388	    two patterns have no common string, which cannot happen for a pair
389	    whose overlap has already been established.
390	    """
391	    n1, n2 = len(t1), len(t2)
392	    best = [[None] * (n2 + 1) for _ in range(n1 + 1)]
393	    best[n1][n2] = (0, "")
394	    for j in range(n2 - 1, -1, -1):
395	        if t2[j][0] == "star":
396	            best[n1][j] = best[n1][j + 1]
397	    for i in range(n1 - 1, -1, -1):
398	        if t1[i][0] == "star":
399	            best[i][n2] = best[i + 1][n2]
400	
401	    for i in range(n1 - 1, -1, -1):
402	        a = t1[i]
403	        a_star = a[0] == "star"
404	        for j in range(n2 - 1, -1, -1):
405	            b = t2[j]
406	            candidates = []
407	            if a_star:
408	                candidates.append(best[i + 1][j])  # a's '*' matches empty
409	                if b[0] == "star":
410	                    candidates.append(best[i][j + 1])
411	                elif _class_satisfiable(b):
412	                    tail = best[i][j + 1]  # a's '*' absorbs b's char
413	                    if tail is not None:
414	                        candidates.append(
415	                            (tail[0] + 1, _token_min_char(b) + tail[1])
416	                        )
417	            elif b[0] == "star":
418	                candidates.append(best[i][j + 1])  # b's '*' matches empty
419	                if _class_satisfiable(a):
420	                    tail = best[i + 1][j]  # b's '*' absorbs a's char
421	                    if tail is not None:
422	                        candidates.append(
423	                            (tail[0] + 1, _token_min_char(a) + tail[1])
424	                        )
425	            else:
426	                ch = _intersection_min_char(a, b)
427	                tail = best[i + 1][j + 1]
428	                if ch is not None and tail is not None:
429	                    candidates.append((tail[0] + 1, ch + tail[1]))
430	            candidates = [c for c in candidates if c is not None]
431	            best[i][j] = min(candidates) if candidates else None
432	
433	    result = best[0][0]
434	    return None if result is None else result[1]
435	
436	
437	def _pattern_satisfiable(tokens):
438	    """True iff the tokenized pattern matches at least one string."""
439	    return all(
440	        token[0] == "star" or _class_satisfiable(token) for token in tokens
441	    )

444	def _min_pattern_string(tokens):
445	    """Shortest string matching one tokenized pattern; ties (impossible
446	    here, each position is forced) would break by Unicode code point.
447	
448	    Every ``char`` token must consume exactly one character, so the
449	    shortest match takes the smallest code point each token accepts and
450	    every ``*`` matches empty. Returns None when the pattern matches no
451	    string at all (an empty character class).
452	    """
453	    chars = []
454	    for token in tokens:
455	        if token[0] == "char":
456	            positive = _positive_ranges(token)
457	            if not positive:
458	                return None
459	            chars.append(chr(positive[0][0]))
460	    return "".join(chars)

463	def _value_matches_pattern(value, pattern):
464	    # A pattern constraint only matches string tag values; anything else
465	    # (including a missing key, surfaced as a non-string here) fails.
466	    return isinstance(value, str) and fnmatch.fnmatchcase(value, pattern)
467

469	def _tag_constraints_compatible(r1, r2, tp1, tp2):
470	    """True iff one tag assignment can satisfy both rules' constraints.
471	
472	    ``tp1``/``tp2`` are the rules' ``tag_patterns`` values compiled by
473	    :func:`_tokenize_pattern`. Constraints on disjoint keys are jointly
474	    satisfiable (the caller may supply extra tags). On a shared key, two
475	    exact values conflict only when unequal, an exact value must match
476	    the pattern, and two patterns need one common string. A pattern
477	    matching no string at all makes its own rule unsatisfiable, so no
478	    request can match both rules.
479	    """
480	    tags1, pats1 = r1["tags"], r1["tag_patterns"]
481	    tags2, pats2 = r2["tags"], r2["tag_patterns"]
482	    for tokens in tp1.values():
483	        if not _pattern_satisfiable(tokens):
484	            return False
485	    for tokens in tp2.values():
486	        if not _pattern_satisfiable(tokens):
487	            return False
488	    for key, value in tags1.items():
489	        if key in tags2:
490	            if tags2[key] != value:
491	                return False
492	        elif key in pats2 and not _value_matches_pattern(value, pats2[key]):
493	            return False
494	    for key, value in tags2.items():
495	        if key in pats1 and not _value_matches_pattern(value, pats1[key]):
496	            return False
497	    for key in pats1:
498	        if key in pats2 and not _patterns_overlap(tp1[key], tp2[key]):

503	def _witness_tags(r1, r2, tp1, tp2):
504	    """Joint tag assignment satisfying both rules' tag constraints.
505	
506	    Only keys constrained by one of the two rules appear, emitted in
507	    Unicode code-point order. An exact constraint pins the value (a
508	    shared exact/pattern key takes the exact value, which the
509	    compatibility check has already proven to match); a key constrained
510	    only by patterns takes the shortest string satisfying every pattern
511	    on it, ties broken by Unicode code-point lexicographic order. Exact
512	    values are deep-copied (direct construction permits mutable tag
513	    values) so a caller mutating a returned report can never touch the
514	    loaded rules or later reports.
515	    """
516	    keys = (
517	        set(r1["tags"])
518	        | set(r1["tag_patterns"])
519	        | set(r2["tags"])
520	        | set(r2["tag_patterns"])
521	    )
522	    merged = {}
523	    for key in keys:
524	        exact = None
525	        have_exact = False
526	        patterns = []
527	        for rule, compiled in ((r1, tp1), (r2, tp2)):
528	            if key in rule["tags"]:
529	                have_exact = True
530	                exact = rule["tags"][key]
531	            elif key in rule["tag_patterns"]:
532	                patterns.append(compiled[key])
533	        if have_exact:
534	            merged[key] = copy.deepcopy(exact)
535	        elif len(patterns) == 1:
536	            merged[key] = _min_pattern_string(patterns[0])
537	        else:
538	            merged[key] = _min_common_string(patterns[0], patterns[1])
539	    return {key: merged[key] for key in sorted(merged)}

543	    """Minimum request matching both selectors of one audited pair."""
544	    return {

546	        "action": _min_common_string(c1[1], c2[1]),
547	        "resource": _min_common_string(c1[2], c2[2]),
548	        "tags": _witness_tags(r1, r2, c1[3], c2[3]),

552	def _patterns_overlap(t1, t2):
553	    """True iff some string matches both tokenized glob patterns.
554	
555	    Dynamic programming over the token grid: dp[i][j] is True when the
556	    suffixes t1[i:] and t2[j:] can match a common string. `*` either
557	    matches empty or absorbs one character matched by the other side.
558	    """
559	    n1, n2 = len(t1), len(t2)
560	    star1 = [True] * (n1 + 1)
561	    for i in range(n1 - 1, -1, -1):
562	        star1[i] = star1[i + 1] and t1[i][0] == "star"
563	    star2 = [True] * (n2 + 1)
564	    for j in range(n2 - 1, -1, -1):
565	        star2[j] = star2[j + 1] and t2[j][0] == "star"
566	
567	    row = bytearray(star2)  # row i == n1: t1 exhausted, t2[j:] must be stars
568	    for i in range(n1 - 1, -1, -1):
569	        cur = bytearray(n2 + 1)
570	        cur[n2] = star1[i]
571	        a = t1[i]
572	        a_star = a[0] == "star"
573	        for j in range(n2 - 1, -1, -1):
574	            b = t2[j]
575	            if a_star and b[0] == "star":
576	                cur[j] = cur[j + 1] or row[j]
577	            elif a_star:
578	                cur[j] = row[j] or (_class_satisfiable(b) and cur[j + 1])
579	            elif b[0] == "star":
580	                cur[j] = cur[j + 1] or (_class_satisfiable(a) and row[j])
581	            else:
582	                cur[j] = _classes_overlap(a, b) and row[j + 1]
583	        row = cur
584	    return bool(row[0])

587	def _audit_pair(r1, r2, c1, c2):
588	    """Build the finding for one rule pair, or None when there is none."""
589	    if not (
590	        _patterns_overlap(c1[0], c2[0])
591	        and _patterns_overlap(c1[1], c2[1])
592	        and _patterns_overlap(c1[2], c2[2])
593	        and _tag_constraints_compatible(r1, r2, c1[3], c2[3])
594	    ):
595	        return None
596	
597	    identical = (
598	        r1["subject"] == r2["subject"]
599	        and r1["action"] == r2["action"]
600	        and r1["resource"] == r2["resource"]
601	        and r1["tags"] == r2["tags"]
602	        and r1["tag_patterns"] == r2["tag_patterns"]
603	    )
604	    if identical:
605	        # Identical selectors: one rule can never win, so it is shadowed.
606	        if r1["effect"] != r2["effect"]:
607	            winner = r1 if r1["effect"] == "deny" else r2
608	            severity = "error"
609	        else:
610	            # r1 is declared earlier, so it wins priority ties.
611	            winner = r1 if r1["priority"] >= r2["priority"] else r2
612	            severity = "warning"
613	        loser = r2 if winner is r1 else r1
614	        if severity == "error":
615	            reason = (
616	                "rule %r is fully shadowed by deny rule %r: identical "
617	                "selectors, and explicit deny overrides allow"
618	                % (loser["id"], winner["id"])
619	            )
620	        else:
621	            reason = (
622	                "rule %r is fully shadowed by rule %r: identical "
623	                "selectors, and priority then declaration order always "
624	                "prefer %r" % (loser["id"], winner["id"], winner["id"])
625	            )
626	        return {
627	            "code": "shadowed_rule",
628	            "severity": severity,
629	            "rule": r1["id"],
630	            "other_rule": r2["id"],
631	            "winner": winner["id"],
632	            "shadowed": loser["id"],
633	            "reason": reason,
634	            "witness": _pair_witness(r1, r2, c1, c2),
635	        }
636	
637	    if r1["effect"] != r2["effect"]:
638	        deny = r1 if r1["effect"] == "deny" else r2
639	        allow = r2 if deny is r1 else r1
640	        return {
641	            "code": "effect_overlap",
642	            "severity": "error",
643	            "rule": r1["id"],
644	            "other_rule": r2["id"],
645	            "winner": deny["id"],
646	            "shadowed": None,
647	            "reason": (
648	                "selectors overlap; explicit deny rule %r overrides allow "
649	                "rule %r for every request matching both, regardless of "
650	                "priority" % (deny["id"], allow["id"])
651	            ),
652	            "witness": _pair_witness(r1, r2, c1, c2),
653	        }
654	
655	    # Same-effect partial overlap is not a conflict.
656	    return None

666	    def __init__(self, rules):

672	            if not isinstance(r, dict):
673	                raise ValueError("rule %d: rule must be a mapping" % i)
674	
675	            effect = r.get("effect")
676	            if effect not in ("allow", "deny"):
677	                raise ValueError(
678	                    "rule %d: field 'effect' must be 'allow' or 'deny'" % i
679	                )

681	            rid = r.get("id", str(i))
682	            if not isinstance(rid, str) or not rid:

684	                    "rule %d: field 'id' must be a non-empty string" % i
685	                )

687	                raise ValueError("rule %d: duplicate id %r" % (i, rid))

690	            priority = r.get("priority", 0)
691	            if not isinstance(priority, int) or isinstance(priority, bool):
692	                raise ValueError(
693	                    "rule %d: field 'priority' must be a non-boolean integer" % i

698	                    raise ValueError(
699	                        "rule %d: field %r must be a string" % (i, field)
700	                    )

702	            tags = r.get("tags", {})
703	            if not isinstance(tags, dict) or not all(
704	                isinstance(k, str) for k in tags
705	            ):
706	                raise ValueError(
707	                    "rule %d: field 'tags' must be a mapping with string keys" % i
708	                )
709	
710	            tag_patterns = r.get("tag_patterns", {})
711	            if (
712	                not isinstance(tag_patterns, dict)

717	                    "invalid_tag_patterns: rule %d: field 'tag_patterns' "
718	                    "must be a mapping with string keys and string pattern "
719	                    "values" % i

730	            if unsupported:

732	                    "rule %d: unsupported field %r" % (i, sorted(unsupported)[0])

735	            self.rules.append(
736	                {
737	                    "id": rid,
738	                    "effect": effect,
739	                    "priority": priority,

741	                    "action": r.get("action", "*"),
742	                    "resource": r.get("resource", "*"),

920	            winner["id"],
921	            winner["priority"],

924	            reason += "; explicit deny overrides allow"

926	            {"effect": winner["effect"], "rule": winner["id"], "reason": reason},

1	# Policy Gate
2	
3	A dependency-free Python reference implementation for security, policy-as-code, rbac.
4	
5	Run with: python3 demo.py
6	Tests: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
7	
8	## Scope
9	
10	实现一个无网络的策略判定器，按主体、动作、资源和标签匹配规则并返回可解释的 allow 或 deny 决策。规则优先级、显式拒绝、默认拒绝、通配匹配和冲突处理必须有稳定定义；判定结果要包含命中的规则和原因，配置错误在加载阶段失败，便于在发布前做离线安全检查。
11	
12	## 发布前审计
13	
14	`PolicyGate.audit()` 对已加载的规则做纯离线静态检查（不接收请求、无 I/O、不修改规则或后续判定），返回 `{"findings": [...], "summary": {"total", "error", "warning"}}`：
15	
16	- 按声明顺序检查每对规则；主体/动作/资源模式按 `fnmatch.fnmatchcase` 真实语义判断是否存在共同匹配字符串，标签约束仅在同键不同值时冲突。
17	- 非等价选择器且 effect 不同的重叠产生一条 `effect_overlap`（error），`winner` 为重叠范围内获胜的 deny 规则（显式拒绝覆盖 allow，priority 不改变结果）。
18	- 三个模式文本和标签完全相同的选择器产生一条 `shadowed_rule`：allow 被 deny 遮蔽为 error，相同 effect 为 warning（按优先级再按声明顺序确定被遮蔽方）。
19	- 相同 effect 的部分重叠不算冲突。每条 finding 固定含 `code`、`severity`、`rule`、`other_rule`、`winner`、`shadowed`、`reason`、`witness`；无法完全遮蔽时 `shadowed` 为 `None`。无重叠选择器时返回空报告。
20	- `witness` 是一个确实能触发该 finding 的最小见证请求，固定含 `subject`、`action`、`resource`、`tags` 四个键：把它交回 `decide`/`explain` 必然同时命中该对规则（`effect_overlap` 下 deny 必然最终生效）。三个字符串字段各自独立地取所有同时匹配两条规则 `fnmatch.fnmatchcase` 模式的字符串中最短者，长度相同取 Unicode 码点字典序最小者，允许空字符串；`tags` 只合并两条规则的标签约束（共享键值在产生 finding 时必相同，互不冲突的键全部保留，键按 Unicode 码点顺序输出，不凭空添加标签）。直接构造与 `from_json` 得到的相同规则生成完全相同的 witness，重复调用返回相等结果，修改返回的报告不影响后续调用。
21	
22	## 可复核策略快照
23	
24	`PolicyGate.to_json()` 把已加载规则导出为规范的严格 JSON 文本，供发布前离线比较；`fingerprint()` 返回同一快照 UTF-8 字节的 SHA-256 小写十六进制摘要（固定 64 字符）。
25	
26	- 根为数组，规则保持声明顺序；每条规则按固定顺序写出归一化后实际生效的 `id`、`effect`、`priority`、`subject`、`action`、`resource`、`tags`，默认值显式出现，内部 `_index` 不泄露。
27	- `tags` 及其任意层级嵌套对象的键按 Unicode 码位排序；使用紧凑分隔符（无空白），非 ASCII 字符原样保留（不转义）。空规则导出 `[]`；规则不变时重复调用得到逐字节相同的文本。
28	- 导出文本可由 `from_json` 无损重新加载，重载后的 `decide`、`explain`、`decide_many`、`audit` 与原实例完全一致；导出不修改规则或调用方提供的映射。
29	- 直接构造的规则若含不能无损表示为严格 JSON 的值（元组、集合、非有限数字、含非字符串键的嵌套映射，或无法 UTF-8 编码的孤立代理项），`to_json` 与 `fingerprint` 均抛出消息含固定标识 `non_json_value` 的 `ValueError`，且不返回任何部分文本。
30	- 快照功能纯离线：无文件、网络或其他外部 I/O。
31	
32	## 策略版本回归比较
33	
34	`PolicyGate.compare(candidate, requests)` 把调用对象作为基线、`candidate`（必须为 `PolicyGate`，否则抛 `TypeError`）作为候选，对同一批请求分别按各自既有的通配、显式 deny、priority、声明顺序和默认 deny 规则判定，定位候选改动。
35	
36	- `requests` 沿用 `decide_many` 的 list/tuple 与请求映射；`subject`、`action`、`resource` 为必填字符串，`tags` 可省略、为 `None` 或 mapping。比较前完整校验容器、元素、未知键、缺失键和类型，沿用 `PolicyBatchError` 的 `code`、`index`、`field`；第一处错误立即终止，不返回部分结果。空批次返回全零汇总。
37	- 返回 `{"changes": [...], "summary": {"total", "unchanged", "changed", "allow_to_deny", "deny_to_allow", "winner_changed"}}`；`total` 为请求数，`changed` 等于三类变化计数之和。
38	- `changes` 按输入顺序列出完整 `decide` 结果不同的请求，每项含 `index`、`before`、`after`、`kind`：effect 从 allow 变 deny / deny 变 allow 时 `kind` 分别为 `allow_to_deny` / `deny_to_allow`；effect 相同但 `rule` 或 `reason` 改变时为 `winner_changed`；完全相同只计入 `unchanged`。
39	- 比较只读且纯离线：不修改任一 gate、请求或标签映射，无 I/O，重复调用结果相同；不改变 `decide`、`decide_many`、`explain`、`audit`、`from_json`、`to_json`、`fingerprint` 的既有行为。
40	
41	## 请求覆盖报告
42	
43	`PolicyGate.coverage(requests)` 用一批请求检查每条规则是否参与判定及赢得多少次，纯离线、只读，不改变任何判定结果。
44	
45	- `requests` 沿用 `decide_many` 的边界：只接受 list 或 tuple，每项是含 `subject`、`action`、`resource` 字符串、可选 `tags` 的映射。整批先校验；未知字段、缺少字段、字段类型错误、非映射元素或批次容器错误均抛 `PolicyBatchError`（保留 `code`、`index`、`field`），不返回部分报告。
46	- 返回 `{"rules": [...], "summary": {...}}`。`rules` 按声明顺序列出每条规则的 `id`、`effect`、`matched`、`winner`：`matched` 是选择器（`fnmatch.fnmatchcase` 通配 + 标签精确约束）与请求匹配的次数，`winner` 是经显式 deny 优先、同效果按 priority 再按声明顺序决胜后最终胜出的次数。同一请求命中多条规则时所有命中规则的 `matched` 都计数，只有最终规则的 `winner` 计数；落入默认拒绝不增加任何规则的 `winner`。
47	- `summary` 固定含 `total`、`allow`、`explicit_deny`、`default_deny`、`matched_request`：`allow` 为最终效果为 allow 的请求数，`explicit_deny` 为由 deny 规则赢得的请求数，`default_deny` 为无匹配规则落入默认拒绝的请求数，`matched_request` 为至少命中一条规则的请求数。空批次返回全零计数；空规则集按请求数统计 `default_deny`。
48	- 报告结构及字段顺序稳定，重复调用得到相同值；不修改规则或调用方映射，不进行 I/O。
49	
50	## 逐规则判定追踪
51	
52	`PolicyGate.trace(subject, action, resource, tags=None)` 在保留 `decide` 判定结果的基础上，附带给定请求对每条规则的逐项匹配细节，供离线审查；`PolicyGate.trace_many(requests)` 生成批量追踪。
53	
54	- 输入校验与 `decide` 完全一致（非法主体/动作/资源/标签类型抛同样的 `TypeError`）；返回映射的根级 `effect`、`rule`、`reason` 与 `decide` 结果逐项相等，并附 `evaluations` 数组。
55	- `evaluations` 按声明顺序覆盖所有规则，每项按固定顺序给出 `id`、`effect`、`priority`、`subject_match`、`action_match`、`resource_match`、`tags_match`、`matched`、`selected`：前三项用 `fnmatch.fnmatchcase` 比较，`tags_match` 使用现有标签精确约束（`tags=None` 视为空映射），`matched` 为四项合取，`selected` 仅最终胜出规则为真；默认拒绝时 `rule` 为 `None` 且所有 `selected` 为假。显式 deny、同效果的 priority 与声明顺序决胜、默认 deny 均沿用现有规则。
56	- `trace_many` 的 `requests` 沿用 `decide_many` 的边界，整批先校验，首个错误抛原有 `PolicyBatchError`（带 `code`、`index`、`field`），不返回部分结果；成功返回 `{"traces": [...], "summary": {"total", "allow", "deny"}}`，`traces` 按输入顺序排列，计数与 `decide_many` 相同，空批次为全零。
57	- 两个入口只读、纯离线：不修改规则或调用方映射，无网络和其他 I/O；直接构造和 `from_json` 加载的规则具有相同追踪语义，且不影响 `decide`、`decide_many`、`explain`、`audit`、`coverage`、`compare`、`from_json`、`to_json`、`fingerprint` 的既有行为。
58	
59	## 发布前固定用例核验
60	
61	`PolicyGate.verify(cases)` 在发布前按一组固定用例核对规则的最终决策，纯离线、只读，不改变规则或输入。
62	
63	- `cases` 只接受 list 或 tuple；每项是映射，只允许 `subject`、`action`、`resource`、`tags`、`expected` 五个键。前三项为必填字符串，`tags` 可省略、为 `None` 或 mapping，匹配完全沿用 `decide` 的 `fnmatch.fnmatchcase` 通配、标签精确约束、显式 deny、priority、声明顺序和默认 deny。
64	- `expected` 必填，是只含 `effect`、`rule` 的映射：`effect` 必须为 `allow` 或 `deny`，`rule` 为字符串或 `null`；默认拒绝必须写成 `{"effect": "deny", "rule": None}`。
65	- 整批先校验再判定，任何错误都抛 `PolicyVerificationError`（带 `code`、`index`、`field`）且不返回部分结果。错误类别依次为：批次容器错误 `invalid_cases`（`index`/`field` 为 `None`）、元素非映射 `item_not_mapping`、未知字段 `unknown_field`、缺失字段 `missing_field`、字段类型错误 `invalid_field_type`、`expected` 取值非法 `invalid_expectation`；`expected` 的嵌套字段写作 `expected.effect`、`expected.rule`。
66	- 校验通过后按输入顺序调用既有 `decide`：仅 `effect` 和 `rule` 同时相等才算通过，`reason` 不参与比较。
67	- 返回固定结构 `{"ok", "failures", "summary"}`：`summary` 含 `total`、`passed`、`failed`；`failures` 按输入顺序给出 `index`、`expected`、`actual`，`actual` 是完整决策（含 `reason`）。`failed` 为零时 `ok` 为 `true`；空批次返回空 `failures`、全零汇总和 `true`。
68	- 返回内容为独立深拷贝，修改返回值不影响后续调用；重复调用、直接构造与 `from_json` 加载的同一规则结果相同。`verify` 不修改任何规则或输入、不产生外部 I/O，也不改变既有公开 API 的校验、字段、优先级与异常行为。
69	
70	## 标签模式约束
71	
72	规则可携带可选的 `tag_patterns` 映射，为一组环境或资源表达标签值的字符串模式，避免重复复制规则；不改变既有规则和任何返回结构。
73	
74	- `tag_patterns` 的键必须是字符串，值是按 `fnmatch.fnmatchcase` 语义解释的字符串模式；同一键不能同时出现在 `tags` 和 `tag_patterns` 中。形状错误在 `PolicyGate` 构造和 `from_json` 加载阶段统一抛出 `ValueError`，消息前缀固定为 `invalid_tag_patterns`（非映射、非字符串键或值）或 `tag_constraint_conflict`（键冲突），不会延迟到 `decide`。未提供该字段按空映射处理，旧规则的决定、批量行为和异常边界保持不变。
75	- 请求的 `tags` 可省略或为任意 mapping；对 `tag_patterns` 而言，缺少键或对应值不是字符串只表示该规则不匹配。规则须同时满足主体、动作、资源、精确标签和所有模式标签，随后继续使用现有的显式 deny、priority、声明顺序和默认拒绝语义。
76	- `explain` 与 `trace` 的字段保持不变，其中 `trace` 的 `tags_match` 反映精确与模式两类标签约束的合取；`decide_many`、`verify`、`coverage`、`compare` 的输出形状和错误码沿用当前定义。
77	- `audit` 把模式标签纳入重叠、遮蔽和 witness 判断：同一键的两个模式只有存在共同字符串才算可满足，精确值与模式同时出现时精确值必须匹配该模式。`witness.tags` 只包含两条规则的约束并按 Unicode 键序输出；每个模式标签取同时满足约束的最短字符串，长度相同按 Unicode 码点字典序，且 witness 能重放 finding。
78	- `to_json` 在规则使用 `tag_patterns` 时按固定顺序紧跟 `tags` 导出该字段，`fingerprint` 随其变化；完全未使用新字段的规则，其 `to_json` 和 `fingerprint` 保持既有字节级结果。经 `from_json` 往返后所有公开方法给出相同结果，功能继续无网络、无外部 I/O。
79

# Policy Gate

A dependency-free Python reference implementation for security, policy-as-code, rbac.

Run with: python3 demo.py
Tests: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v

## Scope

实现一个无网络的策略判定器，按主体、动作、资源和标签匹配规则并返回可解释的 allow 或 deny 决策。规则优先级、显式拒绝、默认拒绝、通配匹配和冲突处理必须有稳定定义；判定结果要包含命中的规则和原因，配置错误在加载阶段失败，便于在发布前做离线安全检查。

## 发布前审计

`PolicyGate.audit()` 对已加载的规则做纯离线静态检查（不接收请求、无 I/O、不修改规则或后续判定），返回 `{"findings": [...], "summary": {"total", "error", "warning"}}`：

- 按声明顺序检查每对规则；主体/动作/资源模式按 `fnmatch.fnmatchcase` 真实语义判断是否存在共同匹配字符串，标签约束仅在同键不同值时冲突。
- 非等价选择器且 effect 不同的重叠产生一条 `effect_overlap`（error），`winner` 为重叠范围内获胜的 deny 规则（显式拒绝覆盖 allow，priority 不改变结果）。
- 三个模式文本和标签完全相同的选择器产生一条 `shadowed_rule`：allow 被 deny 遮蔽为 error，相同 effect 为 warning（按优先级再按声明顺序确定被遮蔽方）。
- 相同 effect 的部分重叠不算冲突。每条 finding 固定含 `code`、`severity`、`rule`、`other_rule`、`winner`、`shadowed`、`reason`、`witness`；无法完全遮蔽时 `shadowed` 为 `None`。无重叠选择器时返回空报告。
- `witness` 是一个确实能触发该 finding 的最小见证请求，固定含 `subject`、`action`、`resource`、`tags` 四个键：把它交回 `decide`/`explain` 必然同时命中该对规则（`effect_overlap` 下 deny 必然最终生效）。三个字符串字段各自独立地取所有同时匹配两条规则 `fnmatch.fnmatchcase` 模式的字符串中最短者，长度相同取 Unicode 码点字典序最小者，允许空字符串；`tags` 只合并两条规则的标签约束（共享键值在产生 finding 时必相同，互不冲突的键全部保留，键按 Unicode 码点顺序输出，不凭空添加标签）。直接构造与 `from_json` 得到的相同规则生成完全相同的 witness，重复调用返回相等结果，修改返回的报告不影响后续调用。

- 输入校验与 `decide` 完全一致（非法主体/动作/资源/标签类型抛同样的 `TypeError`）；返回映射的根级 `effect`、`rule`、`reason` 与 `decide` 结果逐项相等，并附 `evaluations` 数组。
- `evaluations` 按声明顺序覆盖所有规则，每项按固定顺序给出 `id`、`effect`、`priority`、`subject_match`、`action_match`、`resource_match`、`tags_match`、`matched`、`selected`：前三项用 `fnmatch.fnmatchcase` 比较，`tags_match` 使用现有标签精确约束（`tags=None` 视为空映射），`matched` 为四项合取，`selected` 仅最终胜出规则为真；默认拒绝时 `rule` 为 `None` 且所有 `selected` 为假。显式 deny、同效果的 priority 与声明顺序决胜、默认 deny 均沿用现有规则。
- `trace_many` 的 `requests` 沿用 `decide_many` 的边界，整批先校验，首个错误抛原有 `PolicyBatchError`（带 `code`、`index`、`field`），不返回部分结果；成功返回 `{"traces": [...], "summary": {"total", "allow", "deny"}}`，`traces` 按输入顺序排列，计数与 `decide_many` 相同，空批次为全零。
- 两个入口只读、纯离线：不修改规则或调用方映射，无网络和其他 I/O；直接构造和 `from_json` 加载的规则具有相同追踪语义，且不影响 `decide`、`decide_many`、`explain`、`audit`、`coverage`、`compare`、`from_json`、`to_json`、`fingerprint` 的既有行为。

## 发布前固定用例核验

`PolicyGate.verify(cases)` 在发布前按一组固定用例核对规则的最终决策，纯离线、只读，不改变规则或输入。

- `cases` 只接受 list 或 tuple；每项是映射，只允许 `subject`、`action`、`resource`、`tags`、`expected` 五个键。前三项为必填字符串，`tags` 可省略、为 `None` 或 mapping，匹配完全沿用 `decide` 的 `fnmatch.fnmatchcase` 通配、标签精确约束、显式 deny、priority、声明顺序和默认 deny。
- `expected` 必填，是只含 `effect`、`rule` 的映射：`effect` 必须为 `allow` 或 `deny`，`rule` 为字符串或 `null`；默认拒绝必须写成 `{"effect": "deny", "rule": None}`。
- 整批先校验再判定，任何错误都抛 `PolicyVerificationError`（带 `code`、`index`、`field`）且不返回部分结果。错误类别依次为：批次容器错误 `invalid_cases`（`index`/`field` 为 `None`）、元素非映射 `item_not_mapping`、未知字段 `unknown_field`、缺失字段 `missing_field`、字段类型错误 `invalid_field_type`、`expected` 取值非法 `invalid_expectation`；`expected` 的嵌套字段写作 `expected.effect`、`expected.rule`。
- 校验通过后按输入顺序调用既有 `decide`：仅 `effect` 和 `rule` 同时相等才算通过，`reason` 不参与比较。
- 返回固定结构 `{"ok", "failures", "summary"}`：`summary` 含 `total`、`passed`、`failed`；`failures` 按输入顺序给出 `index`、`expected`、`actual`，`actual` 是完整决策（含 `reason`）。`failed` 为零时 `ok` 为 `true`；空批次返回空 `failures`、全零汇总和 `true`。
- 返回内容为独立深拷贝，修改返回值不影响后续调用；重复调用、直接构造与 `from_json` 加载的同一规则结果相同。`verify` 不修改任何规则或输入、不产生外部 I/O，也不改变既有公开 API 的校验、字段、优先级与异常行为。

## 标签模式约束

规则可携带可选的 `tag_patterns` 映射，为一组环境或资源表达标签值的字符串模式，避免重复复制规则；不改变既有规则和任何返回结构。

- `tag_patterns` 的键必须是字符串，值是按 `fnmatch.fnmatchcase` 语义解释的字符串模式；同一键不能同时出现在 `tags` 和 `tag_patterns` 中。形状错误在 `PolicyGate` 构造和 `from_json` 加载阶段统一抛出 `ValueError`，消息前缀固定为 `invalid_tag_patterns`（非映射、非字符串键或值）或 `tag_constraint_conflict`（键冲突），不会延迟到 `decide`。未提供该字段按空映射处理，旧规则的决定、批量行为和异常边界保持不变。
- 请求的 `tags` 可省略或为任意 mapping；对 `tag_patterns` 而言，缺少键或对应值不是字符串只表示该规则不匹配。规则须同时满足主体、动作、资源、精确标签和所有模式标签，随后继续使用现有的显式 deny、priority、声明顺序和默认拒绝语义。
- `explain` 与 `trace` 的字段保持不变，其中 `trace` 的 `tags_match` 反映精确与模式两类标签约束的合取；`decide_many`、`verify`、`coverage`、`compare` 的输出形状和错误码沿用当前定义。
- `audit` 把模式标签纳入重叠、遮蔽和 witness 判断：同一键的两个模式只有存在共同字符串才算可满足，精确值与模式同时出现时精确值必须匹配该模式。`witness.tags` 只包含两条规则的约束并按 Unicode 键序输出；每个模式标签取同时满足约束的最短字符串，长度相同按 Unicode 码点字典序，且 witness 能重放 finding。
- `to_json` 在规则使用 `tag_patterns` 时按固定顺序紧跟 `tags` 导出该字段，`fingerprint` 随其变化；完全未使用新字段的规则，其 `to_json` 和 `fingerprint` 保持既有字节级结果。经 `from_json` 往返后所有公开方法给出相同结果，功能继续无网络、无外部 I/O。

class TagPatternsTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_pattern_match_and_miss(self):
        gate = PolicyGate(
            [{"id": "p", "effect": "allow", "tag_patterns": {"env": "prod-*"}}]
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            gate.decide("s", "a", "r", {"env": "prod-eu"})["rule"], "p"
        )
        self.assertIsNone(gate.decide("s", "a", "r", {"env": "dev-eu"})["rule"])
        # fnmatchcase semantics: case sensitive, character classes work
        self.assertIsNone(gate.decide("s", "a", "r", {"env": "PROD-eu"})["rule"])
        gate = PolicyGate(
            [{"id": "p", "effect": "allow", "tag_patterns": {"env": "prod-?"}}]
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            gate.decide("s", "a", "r", {"env": "prod-1"})["rule"], "p"
        )
        self.assertIsNone(gate.decide("s", "a", "r", {"env": "prod-12"})["rule"])

    def test_missing_key_or_non_string_value_does_not_match(self):
        gate = PolicyGate(
            [{"id": "p", "effect": "allow", "tag_patterns": {"env": "*"}}]
        )
        self.assertIsNone(gate.decide("s", "a", "r")["rule"])
        self.assertIsNone(gate.decide("s", "a", "r", None)["rule"])
        for value in (None, 1, True, ["prod"], {"x": "y"}):
            self.assertIsNone(
                gate.decide("s", "a", "r", {"env": value})["rule"],
                "value %r" % (value,),
            )
        self.assertEqual(gate.decide("s", "a", "r", {"env": ""})["rule"], "p")

    def test_conjunction_with_exact_tags(self):
        gate = PolicyGate(
            [
                {
                    "id": "p",
                    "effect": "allow",
                    "tags": {"team": "core"},
                    "tag_patterns": {"env": "prod-*", "dc": "eu?"},
                }
            ]
        )
        good = {"team": "core", "env": "prod-x", "dc": "eu1"}
        self.assertEqual(gate.decide("s", "a", "r", good)["rule"], "p")
        for mutated in (
            {"team": "core", "env": "prod-x"},  # missing dc
            {"team": "core", "dc": "eu1"},  # missing env
            {"env": "prod-x", "dc": "eu1"},  # missing exact team
            {"team": "other", "env": "prod-x", "dc": "eu1"},
            {"team": "core", "env": "dev-x", "dc": "eu1"},
            {"team": "core", "env": "prod-x", "dc": "eu12"},
        ):
            self.assertIsNone(
                gate.decide("s", "a", "r", mutated)["rule"], repr(mutated)
            )

    def test_deny_priority_and_order_semantics_kept(self):
        gate = PolicyGate(
            [
                {"id": "allow", "effect": "allow", "priority": 10,
                 "tag_patterns": {"env": "prod-*"}},
                {"id": "deny", "effect": "deny", "priority": -1,
                 "tag_patterns": {"env": "*-eu"}},
            ]
        )
        decision = gate.decide("s", "a", "r", {"env": "prod-eu"})
        self.assertEqual((decision["effect"], decision["rule"]), ("deny", "deny"))
        decision = gate.decide("s", "a", "r", {"env": "prod-us"})
        self.assertEqual(
            (decision["effect"], decision["rule"]), ("allow", "allow")
        )

        for bad in (

    witness_tags = _tag_witness_assignment(r1, r2, c1, c2)
    if witness_tags is None:
        return None

    identical = (
        r1["subject"] == r2["subject"]
        and r1["action"] == r2["action"]
        and r1["resource"] == r2["resource"]
        and r1["tags"] == r2["tags"]
        and r1["tag_patterns"] == r2["tag_patterns"]
        and r1["tag_exclude_patterns"] == r2["tag_exclude_patterns"]
    )
    witness = {
        "subject": _min_common_string(c1[0], c2[0]),
        "action": _min_common_string(c1[1], c2[1]),
        "resource": _min_common_string(c1[2], c2[2]),
        "tags": witness_tags,
    }
    if identical:
        # Identical selectors: one rule can never win, so it is shadowed.
        if r1["effect"] != r2["effect"]:
            winner = r1 if r1["effect"] == "deny" else r2
            severity = "error"
        else:
            # r1 is declared earlier, so it wins priority ties.
            winner = r1 if r1["priority"] >= r2["priority"] else r2
            severity = "warning"
        loser = r2 if winner is r1 else r1
        if severity == "error":
            reason = (
                "rule %r is fully shadowed by deny rule %r: identical "
                "selectors, and explicit deny overrides allow"
                % (loser["id"], winner["id"])
            )
        else:
            reason = (
                "rule %r is fully shadowed by rule %r: identical "
                "selectors, and priority then declaration order always "
                "prefer %r" % (loser["id"], winner["id"], winner["id"])
            )
        return {
            "code": "shadowed_rule",
            "severity": severity,
            "rule": r1["id"],
            "other_rule": r2["id"],
            "winner": winner["id"],
            "shadowed": loser["id"],
            "reason": reason,
            "witness": witness,

        deny = r1 if r1["effect"] == "deny" else r2
        allow = r2 if deny is r1 else r1
        return {
            "code": "effect_overlap",

)

    ({}, "e"),

)

- `to_json` 在规则使用 `tag_patterns` 时按固定顺序紧跟 `tags` 导出该字段，`fingerprint` 随其变化；完全未使用新字段的规则，其 `to_json` 和 `fingerprint` 保持既有字节级结果。经 `from_json` 往返后所有公开方法给出相同结果，功能继续无网络、无外部 I/O。

## 标签排除模式约束

规则还可携带可选的 `tag_exclude_patterns` 映射，声明某个标签值**不得**命中指定模式，用于表达“允许生产资源但排除临时环境”这类约束；不使用该字段的旧规则，其判定、异常、审计结果和 `to_json` 字节保持不变。

- `tag_exclude_patterns` 必须是键和值均为字符串的映射；同一规则内与 `tags` 或 `tag_patterns` 出现同名键均失败。形状错误在 `PolicyGate` 构造和 `from_json` 加载阶段统一抛出 `ValueError`，消息前缀固定为 `invalid_tag_exclude_patterns`（非映射、非字符串键或值）或 `tag_constraint_conflict`（与 `tags` / `tag_patterns` 键冲突）；直接构造与 `from_json` 使用同一校验，不会延迟到 `decide`。未提供或为空映射按无排除处理。
- 请求判定时排除约束逐键使用 `fnmatch.fnmatchcase`：缺少该键、值不是字符串、或字符串值不匹配排除模式，该约束都视为通过；只有字符串值命中排除模式才使规则不匹配。主体、动作、资源、`tags` 精确约束、`tag_patterns` 模式约束以及显式 deny、priority、声明顺序和默认 deny 语义全部沿用。
- `trace` 的 `tags_match` 纳入排除约束（与精确/模式约束合取），`decide_many`、`trace_many`、`verify`、`coverage`、`compare` 的返回结构、输入校验和异常类型不变；两个 gate 各自按自己的规则判定。
- `audit` 把排除模式纳入规则重叠、`shadowed_rule`、`effect_overlap` 和 witness：只有存在同时满足双方正向约束（subject/action/resource 模式、精确标签、`tag_patterns`）且避开双方全部 `tag_exclude_patterns` 的标签值时才报告 finding。`witness.tags` 只包含两条规则声明过的键（按 Unicode 码点顺序），无精确值的键取“满足双方正向模式且不命中双方排除模式”的最短字符串，长度相同按 Unicode 码点字典序；无法满足时不生成该 finding（包括排除模式覆盖整个正向语言、或选择器虽完全相同但规则永不可匹配的情形）。
- `to_json` 在 `tag_patterns` 之后的固定位置导出非空 `tag_exclude_patterns`（空映射不出现在快照中，旧规则字节级快照与 `fingerprint` 不变）；映射键递归按 Unicode 码点排序。`from_json` 往返后 `decide`、`explain`、`trace`、批量入口、`audit`、`coverage`、`compare`、`verify` 结果一致；重复调用、修改返回报告均不影响规则与后续结果，功能继续无网络、无外部 I/O。

# Policy Gate

A dependency-free Python reference implementation for security, policy-as-code, rbac.

Run with: python3 demo.py
Tests: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v

## Scope

实现一个无网络的策略判定器，按主体、动作、资源和标签匹配规则并返回可解释的 allow 或 deny 决策。规则优先级、显式拒绝、默认拒绝、通配匹配和冲突处理必须有稳定定义；判定结果要包含命中的规则和原因，配置错误在加载阶段失败，便于在发布前做离线安全检查。

## 发布前审计

`PolicyGate.audit()` 对已加载的规则做纯离线静态检查（不接收请求、无 I/O、不修改规则或后续判定），返回 `{"findings": [...], "summary": {"total", "error", "warning"}}`：

- 按声明顺序检查每对规则；主体/动作/资源模式按 `fnmatch.fnmatchcase` 真实语义判断是否存在共同匹配字符串，标签约束仅在同键不同值时冲突。
- 非等价选择器且 effect 不同的重叠产生一条 `effect_overlap`（error），`winner` 为重叠范围内获胜的 deny 规则（显式拒绝覆盖 allow，priority 不改变结果）。
- 三个模式文本和标签完全相同的选择器产生一条 `shadowed_rule`：allow 被 deny 遮蔽为 error，相同 effect 为 warning（按优先级再按声明顺序确定被遮蔽方）。
- 相同 effect 的部分重叠不算冲突。每条 finding 固定含 `code`、`severity`、`rule`、`other_rule`、`winner`、`shadowed`、`reason`、`witness`；无法完全遮蔽时 `shadowed` 为 `None`。无重叠选择器时返回空报告。
- `witness` 是一个确实能触发该 finding 的最小见证请求，固定含 `subject`、`action`、`resource`、`tags` 四个键：把它交回 `decide`/`explain` 必然同时命中该对规则（`effect_overlap` 下 deny 必然最终生效）。三个字符串字段各自独立地取所有同时匹配两条规则 `fnmatch.fnmatchcase` 模式的字符串中最短者，长度相同取 Unicode 码点字典序最小者，允许空字符串；`tags` 只合并两条规则的标签约束（共享键值在产生 finding 时必相同，互不冲突的键全部保留，键按 Unicode 码点顺序输出，不凭空添加标签）。直接构造与 `from_json` 得到的相同规则生成完全相同的 witness，重复调用返回相等结果，修改返回的报告不影响后续调用。

## 可复核策略快照

`PolicyGate.to_json()` 把已加载规则导出为规范的严格 JSON 文本，供发布前离线比较；`fingerprint()` 返回同一快照 UTF-8 字节的 SHA-256 小写十六进制摘要（固定 64 字符）。

- 根为数组，规则保持声明顺序；每条规则按固定顺序写出归一化后实际生效的 `id`、`effect`、`priority`、`subject`、`action`、`resource`、`tags`，默认值显式出现，内部 `_index` 不泄露。
- `tags` 及其任意层级嵌套对象的键按 Unicode 码位排序；使用紧凑分隔符（无空白），非 ASCII 字符原样保留（不转义）。空规则导出 `[]`；规则不变时重复调用得到逐字节相同的文本。
- 导出文本可由 `from_json` 无损重新加载，重载后的 `decide`、`explain`、`decide_many`、`audit` 与原实例完全一致；导出不修改规则或调用方提供的映射。
- 直接构造的规则若含不能无损表示为严格 JSON 的值（元组、集合、非有限数字、含非字符串键的嵌套映射，或无法 UTF-8 编码的孤立代理项），`to_json` 与 `fingerprint` 均抛出消息含固定标识 `non_json_value` 的 `ValueError`，且不返回任何部分文本。
- 快照功能纯离线：无文件、网络或其他外部 I/O。

## 策略版本回归比较

`PolicyGate.compare(candidate, requests)` 把调用对象作为基线、`candidate`（必须为 `PolicyGate`，否则抛 `TypeError`）作为候选，对同一批请求分别按各自既有的通配、显式 deny、priority、声明顺序和默认 deny 规则判定，定位候选改动。

- `requests` 沿用 `decide_many` 的 list/tuple 与请求映射；`subject`、`action`、`resource` 为必填字符串，`tags` 可省略、为 `None` 或 mapping。比较前完整校验容器、元素、未知键、缺失键和类型，沿用 `PolicyBatchError` 的 `code`、`index`、`field`；第一处错误立即终止，不返回部分结果。空批次返回全零汇总。
- 返回 `{"changes": [...], "summary": {"total", "unchanged", "changed", "allow_to_deny", "deny_to_allow", "winner_changed"}}`；`total` 为请求数，`changed` 等于三类变化计数之和。
- `changes` 按输入顺序列出完整 `decide` 结果不同的请求，每项含 `index`、`before`、`after`、`kind`：effect 从 allow 变 deny / deny 变 allow 时 `kind` 分别为 `allow_to_deny` / `deny_to_allow`；effect 相同但 `rule` 或 `reason` 改变时为 `winner_changed`；完全相同只计入 `unchanged`。
- 比较只读且纯离线：不修改任一 gate、请求或标签映射，无 I/O，重复调用结果相同；不改变 `decide`、`decide_many`、`explain`、`audit`、`from_json`、`to_json`、`fingerprint` 的既有行为。

## 请求覆盖报告

`PolicyGate.coverage(requests)` 用一批请求检查每条规则是否参与判定及赢得多少次，纯离线、只读，不改变任何判定结果。

- `requests` 沿用 `decide_many` 的边界：只接受 list 或 tuple，每项是含 `subject`、`action`、`resource` 字符串、可选 `tags` 的映射。整批先校验；未知字段、缺少字段、字段类型错误、非映射元素或批次容器错误均抛 `PolicyBatchError`（保留 `code`、`index`、`field`），不返回部分报告。
- 返回 `{"rules": [...], "summary": {...}}`。`rules` 按声明顺序列出每条规则的 `id`、`effect`、`matched`、`winner`：`matched` 是选择器（`fnmatch.fnmatchcase` 通配 + 标签精确约束）与请求匹配的次数，`winner` 是经显式 deny 优先、同效果按 priority 再按声明顺序决胜后最终胜出的次数。同一请求命中多条规则时所有命中规则的 `matched` 都计数，只有最终规则的 `winner` 计数；落入默认拒绝不增加任何规则的 `winner`。
- `summary` 固定含 `total`、`allow`、`explicit_deny`、`default_deny`、`matched_request`：`allow` 为最终效果为 allow 的请求数，`explicit_deny` 为由 deny 规则赢得的请求数，`default_deny` 为无匹配规则落入默认拒绝的请求数，`matched_request` 为至少命中一条规则的请求数。空批次返回全零计数；空规则集按请求数统计 `default_deny`。
- 报告结构及字段顺序稳定，重复调用得到相同值；不修改规则或调用方映射，不进行 I/O。

## 逐规则判定追踪

`PolicyGate.trace(subject, action, resource, tags=None)` 在保留 `decide` 判定结果的基础上，附带给定请求对每条规则的逐项匹配细节，供离线审查；`PolicyGate.trace_many(requests)` 生成批量追踪。

- 输入校验与 `decide` 完全一致（非法主体/动作/资源/标签类型抛同样的 `TypeError`）；返回映射的根级 `effect`、`rule`、`reason` 与 `decide` 结果逐项相等，并附 `evaluations` 数组。
- `evaluations` 按声明顺序覆盖所有规则，每项按固定顺序给出 `id`、`effect`、`priority`、`subject_match`、`action_match`、`resource_match`、`tags_match`、`matched`、`selected`：前三项用 `fnmatch.fnmatchcase` 比较，`tags_match` 使用现有标签精确约束（`tags=None` 视为空映射），`matched` 为四项合取，`selected` 仅最终胜出规则为真；默认拒绝时 `rule` 为 `None` 且所有 `selected` 为假。显式 deny、同效果的 priority 与声明顺序决胜、默认 deny 均沿用现有规则。
- `trace_many` 的 `requests` 沿用 `decide_many` 的边界，整批先校验，首个错误抛原有 `PolicyBatchError`（带 `code`、`index`、`field`），不返回部分结果；成功返回 `{"traces": [...], "summary": {"total", "allow", "deny"}}`，`traces` 按输入顺序排列，计数与 `decide_many` 相同，空批次为全零。
- 两个入口只读、纯离线：不修改规则或调用方映射，无网络和其他 I/O；直接构造和 `from_json` 加载的规则具有相同追踪语义，且不影响 `decide`、`decide_many`、`explain`、`audit`、`coverage`、`compare`、`from_json`、`to_json`、`fingerprint` 的既有行为。

## 发布前固定用例核验

`PolicyGate.verify(cases)` 在发布前按一组固定用例核对规则的最终决策，纯离线、只读，不改变规则或输入。

- `cases` 只接受 list 或 tuple；每项是映射，只允许 `subject`、`action`、`resource`、`tags`、`expected` 五个键。前三项为必填字符串，`tags` 可省略、为 `None` 或 mapping，匹配完全沿用 `decide` 的 `fnmatch.fnmatchcase` 通配、标签精确约束、显式 deny、priority、声明顺序和默认 deny。
- `expected` 必填，是只含 `effect`、`rule` 的映射：`effect` 必须为 `allow` 或 `deny`，`rule` 为字符串或 `null`；默认拒绝必须写成 `{"effect": "deny", "rule": None}`。
- 整批先校验再判定，任何错误都抛 `PolicyVerificationError`（带 `code`、`index`、`field`）且不返回部分结果。错误类别依次为：批次容器错误 `invalid_cases`（`index`/`field` 为 `None`）、元素非映射 `item_not_mapping`、未知字段 `unknown_field`、缺失字段 `missing_field`、字段类型错误 `invalid_field_type`、`expected` 取值非法 `invalid_expectation`；`expected` 的嵌套字段写作 `expected.effect`、`expected.rule`。
- 校验通过后按输入顺序调用既有 `decide`：仅 `effect` 和 `rule` 同时相等才算通过，`reason` 不参与比较。
- 返回固定结构 `{"ok", "failures", "summary"}`：`summary` 含 `total`、`passed`、`failed`；`failures` 按输入顺序给出 `index`、`expected`、`actual`，`actual` 是完整决策（含 `reason`）。`failed` 为零时 `ok` 为 `true`；空批次返回空 `failures`、全零汇总和 `true`。
- 返回内容为独立深拷贝，修改返回值不影响后续调用；重复调用、直接构造与 `from_json` 加载的同一规则结果相同。`verify` 不修改任何规则或输入、不产生外部 I/O，也不改变既有公开 API 的校验、字段、优先级与异常行为。

## 标签模式约束

规则可携带可选的 `tag_patterns` 映射，为一组环境或资源表达标签值的字符串模式，避免重复复制规则；不改变既有规则和任何返回结构。

- `tag_patterns` 的键必须是字符串，值是按 `fnmatch.fnmatchcase` 语义解释的字符串模式；同一键不能同时出现在 `tags` 和 `tag_patterns` 中。形状错误在 `PolicyGate` 构造和 `from_json` 加载阶段统一抛出 `ValueError`，消息前缀固定为 `invalid_tag_patterns`（非映射、非字符串键或值）或 `tag_constraint_conflict`（键冲突），不会延迟到 `decide`。未提供该字段按空映射处理，旧规则的决定、批量行为和异常边界保持不变。
- 请求的 `tags` 可省略或为任意 mapping；对 `tag_patterns` 而言，缺少键或对应值不是字符串只表示该规则不匹配。规则须同时满足主体、动作、资源、精确标签和所有模式标签，随后继续使用现有的显式 deny、priority、声明顺序和默认拒绝语义。
- `explain` 与 `trace` 的字段保持不变，其中 `trace` 的 `tags_match` 反映精确与模式两类标签约束的合取；`decide_many`、`verify`、`coverage`、`compare` 的输出形状和错误码沿用当前定义。
- `audit` 把模式标签纳入重叠、遮蔽和 witness 判断：同一键的两个模式只有存在共同字符串才算可满足，精确值与模式同时出现时精确值必须匹配该模式。`witness.tags` 只包含两条规则的约束并按 Unicode 键序输出；每个模式标签取同时满足约束的最短字符串，长度相同按 Unicode 码点字典序，且 witness 能重放 finding。
- `to_json` 在规则使用 `tag_patterns` 时按固定顺序紧跟 `tags` 导出该字段，`fingerprint` 随其变化；完全未使用新字段的规则，其 `to_json` 和 `fingerprint` 保持既有字节级结果。经 `from_json` 往返后所有公开方法给出相同结果，功能继续无网络、无外部 I/O。

+规则还可携带可选的 `tag_exclude_patterns` 映射，声明某个标签值**不得**命中指定模式，用于表达“允许生产资源但排除临时环境”这类约束；不使用该字段的旧规则，其判定、异常、审计结果和 `to_json` 字节保持不变。

+- `tag_exclude_patterns` 必须是键和值均为字符串的映射；同一规则内与 `tags` 或 `tag_patterns` 出现同名键均失败。形状错误在 `PolicyGate` 构造和 `from_json` 加载阶段统一抛出 `ValueError`，消息前缀固定为 `invalid_tag_exclude_patterns`（非映射、非字符串键或值）或 `tag_constraint_conflict`（与 `tags` / `tag_patterns` 键冲突）；直接构造与 `from_json` 使用同一校验，不会延迟到 `decide`。未提供或为空映射按无排除处理。
+- 请求判定时排除约束逐键使用 `fnmatch.fnmatchcase`：缺少该键、值不是字符串、或字符串值不匹配排除模式，该约束都视为通过；只有字符串值命中排除模式才使规则不匹配。主体、动作、资源、`tags` 精确约束、`tag_patterns` 模式约束以及显式 deny、priority、声明顺序和默认 deny 语义全部沿用。
+- `trace` 的 `tags_match` 纳入排除约束（与精确/模式约束合取），`decide_many`、`trace_many`、`verify`、`coverage`、`compare` 的返回结构、输入校验和异常类型不变；两个 gate 各自按自己的规则判定。

+- `audit` 把排除模式纳入规则重叠、`shadowed_rule`、`effect_overlap` 和 witness：只有存在同时满足双方正向约束（subject/action/resource 模式、精确标签、`tag_patterns`）且避开双方全部 `tag_exclude_patterns` 的标签值时才报告 finding。`witness.tags` 只包含两条规则声明过的键（按 Unicode 码点顺序），无精确值的键取“满足双方正向模式且不命中双方排除模式”的最短字符串，长度相同按 Unicode 码点字典序；无法满足时不生成该 finding（包括排除模式覆盖整个正向语言、或选择器虽完全相同但规则永不可匹配的情形）。

+- `to_json` 在 `tag_patterns` 之后的固定位置导出非空 `tag_exclude_patterns`（空映射不出现在快照中，旧规则字节级快照与 `fingerprint` 不变）；映射键递归按 Unicode 码点排序。`from_json` 往返后 `decide`、`explain`、`trace`、批量入口、`audit`、`coverage`、`compare`、`verify` 结果一致；重复调用、修改返回报告均不影响规则与后续结果，功能继续无网络、无外部 I/O。

class TagExcludePatternsTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_exclude_match_and_miss(self):
        gate = PolicyGate(
            [
                {
                    "id": "p",
                    "effect": "allow",
                    "tag_patterns": {"env": "prod-*"},
                    "tag_exclude_patterns": {"phase": "temp*"},
                }
            ]
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            gate.decide("s", "a", "r", {"env": "prod-eu"})["rule"], "p"
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            gate.decide(
                "s", "a", "r", {"env": "prod-eu", "phase": "stable"}
            )["rule"],
            "p",
        )
        for value in ("temp", "temporary", "TEMP"):
            self.assertIsNone(
                gate.decide(
                    "s", "a", "r",
                    {"env": "prod-eu", "phase": value},
                )["rule"],
                repr(value),
            )
        # case sensitive: an excluded pattern never matches loosely
        self.assertEqual(
            gate.decide(
                "s", "a", "r",
                {"env": "prod-eu", "phase": "temped-long"},
            )["rule"],
            "p" if False else None,
        )

    def test_exclude_only_rule_passes_on_missing_or_non_string(self):
        gate = PolicyGate(
            [
                {
                    "id": "e",
                    "effect": "allow",
                    "tag_exclude_patterns": {"env": "tmp-*"},
                }
            ]
        )
        self.assertEqual(gate.decide("s", "a", "r")["rule"], "e")
        self.assertEqual(gate.decide("s", "a", "r", None)["rule"], "e")
        self.assertEqual(gate.decide("s", "a", "r", {})["rule"], "e")
        for value in (None, 1, True, ["tmp"], {"x": "y"}):
            self.assertEqual(
                gate.decide("s", "a", "r", {"env": value})["rule"],
                "e",
                "value %r" % (value,),
            )
        self.assertIsNone(
            gate.decide("s", "a", "r", {"env": "tmp-x"})["rule"]
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            gate.decide("s", "a", "r", {"env": "prod"})["rule"], "e"
        )

    def test_conjunction_with_exact_and_patterns(self):
        gate = PolicyGate(
            [
                {
                    "id": "p",
                    "effect": "allow",
                    "tags": {"team": "core"},
                    "tag_patterns": {"env": "prod-*"},
                    "tag_exclude_patterns": {"dc": "legacy", "phase": "t*"},
                }
            ]
        )
        good = {"team": "core", "env": "prod-x", "dc": "new", "phase": "ga"}
        self.assertEqual(gate.decide("s", "a", "r", good)["rule"], "p")
        for mutated in (
            {"team": "core", "env": "prod-x", "dc": "legacy"},
            {"team": "core", "env": "prod-x", "phase": "temp"},
            {"team": "core", "env": "prod-x", "phase": "ga", "dc": 5},
        ):
            # non-string dc passes the exclusion, the rest still match
            expected = "p" if mutated.get("dc") == 5 else None
            self.assertEqual(
                gate.decide("s", "a", "r", mutated)["rule"],
                expected,
                repr(mutated),
            )

    def test_deny_priority_and_order_semantics_kept(self):
        gate = PolicyGate(
            [
                {"id": "allow", "effect": "allow", "priority": 10,
                 "tag_exclude_patterns": {"env": "x*"}},
                {"id": "deny", "effect": "deny", "priority": -1,
                 "tag_exclude_patterns": {"env": "y*"}},
            ]
        )
        decision = gate.decide("s", "a", "r", {"env": "z"})
        self.assertEqual((decision["effect"], decision["rule"]),
                         ("deny", "deny"))
        decision = gate.decide("s", "a", "r", {"env": "y"})
        self.assertEqual((decision["effect"], decision["rule"]),
                         ("allow", "allow"))

    def test_empty_and_missing_excludes_behave_like_legacy(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            PolicyGate([{"id": "p", "effect": "allow",
                         "tag_exclude_patterns": {}}]).to_json(),
            PolicyGate([{"id": "p", "effect": "allow"}]).to_json(),
        )
        patterned = PolicyGate(
            [{"id": "p", "effect": "allow",
              "tag_patterns": {"env": "p*"},
              "tag_exclude_patterns": {}}]
        ).to_json()
        self.assertEqual(
            patterned,
            PolicyGate([{"id": "p", "effect": "allow",
                         "tag_patterns": {"env": "p*"}}]).to_json(),
        )
        gate = PolicyGate(
            [{"id": "p", "effect": "allow",
              "tag_exclude_patterns": {}}]
        )
        self.assertEqual(gate.decide("s", "a", "r")["rule"], "p")

    def test_invalid_tag_exclude_patterns_shape(self):
        for bad in (
            "x",
            ["env"],
            ("env",),
            None,
            True,
            1,
            {"env": 1},
            {"env": None},
            {"env": True},
            {"env": ["*"]},
            {1: "*"},
            {"env": "*", 2: "x"},
        ):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as ctx:
                PolicyGate(
                    [{"effect": "allow",
                      "tag_exclude_patterns": bad}]
                )
            self.assertTrue(
                str(ctx.exception).startswith(
                    "invalid_tag_exclude_patterns"
                ),
                "%r -> %s" % (bad, ctx.exception),
            )

    def test_invalid_tag_exclude_patterns_names_rule_index(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as ctx:
            PolicyGate(
                [{"effect": "allow"},
                 {"effect": "deny", "tag_exclude_patterns": "x"}]
            )
        self.assertIn("rule 1", str(ctx.exception))

    def test_tag_constraint_conflict_with_tags_and_patterns(self):
        for other in ("tags", "tag_patterns"):
            rule = {"effect": "allow",
                    "tag_exclude_patterns": {"env": "tmp*"}}
            rule[other] = {"env": "p*" if other == "tag_patterns" else "p"}
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as ctx:
                PolicyGate([rule])
            self.assertTrue(
                str(ctx.exception).startswith("tag_constraint_conflict")
            )
            self.assertIn("'env'", str(ctx.exception))
        # disjoint keys are fine
        gate = PolicyGate(
            [
                {
                    "effect": "allow",
                    "tags": {"team": "core"},
                    "tag_patterns": {"env": "p*"},
                    "tag_exclude_patterns": {"dc": "legacy"},
                }
            ]
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            gate.decide(
                "s", "a", "r",
                {"team": "core", "env": "p1", "dc": "new"},
            )["rule"],
            "0",
        )

    def test_from_json_raises_same_value_errors(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as ctx:
            PolicyGate.from_json(
                '[{"effect": "allow",'
                ' "tag_exclude_patterns": {"env": 1}}]'
            )
        self.assertTrue(
            str(ctx.exception).startswith(
                "invalid_tag_exclude_patterns"
            )
        )
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as ctx:
            PolicyGate.from_json(
                '[{"effect": "allow", "tags": {"env": "a"},'
                ' "tag_exclude_patterns": {"env": "a*"}}]'
            )
        self.assertTrue(
            str(ctx.exception).startswith("tag_constraint_conflict")
        )
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as ctx:
            PolicyGate.from_json(
                '[{"effect": "allow", "tag_patterns": {"env": "a*"},'
                ' "tag_exclude_patterns": {"env": "b*"}}]'
            )
        self.assertTrue(
            str(ctx.exception).startswith("tag_constraint_conflict")
        )

    def test_trace_tags_match_includes_exclusions(self):
        gate = PolicyGate(
            [
                {
                    "id": "p",
                    "effect": "allow",
                    "tags": {"team": "core"},
                    "tag_patterns": {"env": "prod-*"},
                    "tag_exclude_patterns": {"dc": "legacy"},
                }
            ]
        )

        def tags_match(tags):
            return gate.trace(
                "s", "a", "r", tags
            )["evaluations"][0]["tags_match"]

        self.assertTrue(
            tags_match({"team": "core", "env": "prod-1", "dc": "new"})
        )
        self.assertTrue(tags_match({"team": "core", "env": "prod-1"}))
        self.assertTrue(
            tags_match({"team": "core", "env": "prod-1", "dc": 5})
        )
        self.assertFalse(
            tags_match({"team": "core", "env": "prod-1", "dc": "legacy"})
        )
        self.assertFalse(tags_match(None))

    def test_batch_entry_points_use_exclusions(self):
        gate = PolicyGate(
            [
                {
                    "id": "p",
                    "effect": "allow",
                    "tag_patterns": {"env": "prod-*"},
                    "tag_exclude_patterns": {"phase": "temp*"},
                }
            ]
        )
        batch = [
            {"subject": "s", "action": "a", "resource": "r",
             "tags": {"env": "prod-eu", "phase": "ga"}},
            {"subject": "s", "action": "a", "resource": "r",
             "tags": {"env": "prod-eu", "phase": "temp"}},
            {"subject": "s", "action": "a", "resource": "r",
             "tags": {"env": "prod-eu"}},
        ]
        self.assertEqual(
            gate.decide_many(batch)["summary"],
            {"total": 3, "allow": 2, "deny": 1},
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            gate.trace_many(batch)["summary"],
            {"total": 3, "allow": 2, "deny": 1},
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            gate.coverage(batch)["rules"],
            [{"id": "p", "effect": "allow", "matched": 2, "winner": 2}],
        )
        cases = [
            {"subject": "s", "action": "a", "resource": "r",
             "tags": {"env": "prod-eu"},
             "expected": {"effect": "allow", "rule": "p"}},
            {"subject": "s", "action": "a", "resource": "r",
             "tags": {"env": "prod-eu", "phase": "temp"},
             "expected": {"effect": "deny", "rule": None}},
        ]
        self.assertTrue(gate.verify(cases)["ok"])
        # input validation exception surface is unchanged
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            gate.trace("s", "a", "r", 5)
        with self.assertRaises(Exception) as ctx:
            gate.decide_many(
                [{"subject": "s", "action": "a", "resource": "r",
                  "unknown": 1}]
            )
        self.assertEqual(type(ctx.exception).__name__, "PolicyBatchError")
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.code, "missing_field")

    def test_compare_against_candidate_with_exclusions(self):
        baseline = PolicyGate(
            [{"id": "a", "effect": "allow",
              "tag_patterns": {"env": "prod-*"}}]
        )
        candidate = PolicyGate(
            [
                {
                    "id": "a",
                    "effect": "allow",
                    "tag_patterns": {"env": "prod-*"},
                    "tag_exclude_patterns": {"phase": "temp*"},
                }
            ]
        )
        batch = [
            {"subject": "s", "action": "a", "resource": "r",
             "tags": {"env": "prod-eu", "phase": "temp"}},
            {"subject": "s", "action": "a", "resource": "r",
             "tags": {"env": "prod-eu"}},
        ]
        report = baseline.compare(candidate, batch)
        self.assertEqual(report["summary"]["changed"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(report["summary"]["allow_to_deny"], 1)

    def test_audit_overlap_with_exclusions_and_witness_replay(self):
        gate = PolicyGate(
            [
                {"id": "a", "effect": "allow",
                 "tag_patterns": {"env": "prod-*"}},
                {"id": "d", "effect": "deny",
                 "tag_exclude_patterns": {"env": "prod-eu"}},
            ]
        )
        (finding,) = gate.audit()["findings"]
        self.assertEqual(finding["code"], "effect_overlap")
        self.assertEqual(finding["winner"], "d")
        witness = finding["witness"]
        self.assertEqual(witness["tags"], {"env": "prod-"})
        decision = gate.decide(
            witness["subject"], witness["action"], witness["resource"],
            witness["tags"],
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            (decision["effect"], decision["rule"]), ("deny", "d")
        )

    def test_audit_no_finding_when_exclude_covers_positive_language(self):
        gate = PolicyGate(
            [
                {"id": "a", "effect": "allow",
                 "tag_patterns": {"env": "tmp-*"}},
                {"id": "d", "effect": "deny",
                 "tag_exclude_patterns": {"env": "tmp-*"}},
            ]
        )
        self.assertEqual(gate.audit()["findings"], [])
        # identical selectors that no tag value can satisfy produce no
        # shadowing finding either
        gate = PolicyGate(
            [
                {"id": "a1", "effect": "allow",
                 "tag_exclude_patterns": {"env": "*"}},
                {"id": "a2", "effect": "allow",
                 "tag_exclude_patterns": {"env": "*"}},
            ]
        )
        self.assertEqual(gate.audit()["findings"], [])

    def test_audit_shadowed_identical_selectors_with_excludes(self):
        gate = PolicyGate(
            [
                {"id": "a1", "effect": "allow",
                 "tag_patterns": {"env": "p*"},
                 "tag_exclude_patterns": {"dc": "legacy"}},
                {"id": "a2", "effect": "allow",
                 "tag_patterns": {"env": "p*"},
                 "tag_exclude_patterns": {"dc": "legacy"}},
            ]
        )
        (finding,) = gate.audit()["findings"]
        self.assertEqual(finding["code"], "shadowed_rule")
        self.assertEqual(finding["winner"], "a1")
        self.assertEqual(finding["shadowed"], "a2")
        self.assertEqual(
            finding["witness"]["tags"], {"dc": "", "env": "p"}
        )
        # different exclude texts: not identical, same effect, no finding
        gate = PolicyGate(
            [
                {"id": "a1", "effect": "allow",
                 "tag_patterns": {"env": "p*"},
                 "tag_exclude_patterns": {"dc": "x*"}},
                {"id": "a2", "effect": "allow",
                 "tag_patterns": {"env": "p*"},
                 "tag_exclude_patterns": {"dc": "y*"}},
            ]
        )
        self.assertEqual(gate.audit()["findings"], [])

    def test_audit_exact_value_against_other_exclude(self):
        gate = PolicyGate(
            [
                {"id": "a", "effect": "allow", "tags": {"env": "tmp"}},
                {"id": "d", "effect": "deny",
                 "tag_exclude_patterns": {"env": "tmp"}},
            ]
        )
        self.assertEqual(gate.audit()["findings"], [])
        # a non-string exact value cannot match the excluded pattern, so
        # the exclusion passes and the overlap remains
        gate = PolicyGate(
            [
                {"id": "a", "effect": "allow", "tags": {"env": 1}},
                {"id": "d", "effect": "deny",
                 "tag_exclude_patterns": {"env": "*"}},
            ]
        )
        (finding,) = gate.audit()["findings"]
        self.assertEqual(finding["witness"]["tags"], {"env": 1})

    def test_audit_witness_avoids_excludes_and_is_shortest(self):
        gate = PolicyGate(
            [
                {"id": "a", "effect": "allow",
                 "tag_patterns": {"env": "*"}},
                {"id": "d", "effect": "deny",
                 "tag_exclude_patterns": {"env": ""}},
            ]
        )
        (finding,) = gate.audit()["findings"]
        # empty string is the usual shortest witness but is excluded, so
        # the shortest one-character string is chosen
        self.assertEqual(finding["witness"]["tags"], {"env": "\x00"})

        gate = PolicyGate(
            [
                {"id": "a", "effect": "allow",
                 "tag_exclude_patterns": {"b": "x*"}},
                {"id": "d", "effect": "deny",
                 "tag_patterns": {"a": "y[0-9]", "b": "*1"}},
            ]
        )
        (finding,) = gate.audit()["findings"]
        tags = finding["witness"]["tags"]
        self.assertEqual(list(tags), ["a", "b"])
        self.assertEqual(tags["a"], "y0")
        self.assertEqual(tags["b"], "1")  # "x1" would hit x*; "1" is free
        decision = gate.decide(
            finding["witness"]["subject"],
            finding["witness"]["action"],
            finding["witness"]["resource"],
            tags,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            (decision["effect"], decision["rule"]), ("deny", "d")
        )

    def test_audit_report_is_stable_under_mutation(self):

class TagExcludePatternsTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_exclude_match_and_miss(self):
        gate = PolicyGate(
            [
                {
                    "id": "p",
                    "effect": "allow",
                    "tag_patterns": {"env": "prod-*"},
                    "tag_exclude_patterns": {"phase": "temp*"},
                }
            ]
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            gate.decide("s", "a", "r", {"env": "prod-eu"})["rule"], "p"
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            gate.decide(
                "s", "a", "r", {"env": "prod-eu", "phase": "stable"}
            )["rule"],
            "p",
        )
        for value in ("temp", "temporary", "TEMP"):
            self.assertIsNone(
                gate.decide(
                    "s", "a", "r",
                    {"env": "prod-eu", "phase": value},
                )["rule"],
                repr(value),
            )
        # case sensitive: an excluded pattern never matches loosely
        self.assertEqual(
            gate.decide(
                "s", "a", "r",
                {"env": "prod-eu", "phase": "temped-long"},
            )["rule"],
            "p" if False else None,
        )

        for value in (None, 1, True, ["tmp"], {"x": "y"}):
            self.assertEqual(

content.text:
Done. `tag_exclude_patterns` is implemented end-to-end on the PolicyGate baseline. Summary of the changes:

## `app.py`

**Validation (constructor + `from_json` shared path)**
- New allowed rule field; must be a mapping with string keys and string pattern values, else `ValueError` prefixed `invalid_tag_exclude_patterns`.
- A key shared with `tags` or `tag_patterns` fails with the `tag_constraint_conflict` prefix. Missing/empty defaults to `{}`.

**Matching (`decide`/`explain`/all batch entries via `_tags_match`)**
- Each exclude is applied per key with `fnmatch.fnmatchcase`: missing key, non-string value, or non-matching value all pass; only a string matching the excluded pattern makes the rule not match. Subject/action/resource, existing tag constraints, explicit deny, priority, declaration order and default deny are untouched, so `decide_many`/`trace_many`/`coverage`/`compare`/`verify` inherit the semantics with unchanged structures and exception types. `trace`'s `tags_match` is the conjunction including exclusions.

**Audit (the hard part)**
- Replaced the old pairwise compatibility/witness helpers with a subset-NFA BFS solver (`_constraints_min_string`): it jointly drives up to two positive glob NFAs and up to two excluded NFAs per tag key, prunes chars to the elementary codepoint intervals live in the frontier, explores length layers and picks the smallest codepoint — yielding the shortest witness with Unicode-codepoint tie-break, returning `None` when the excluded language covers the positive language.
- `_tag_witness_assignment` handles exact values (pinned, deep-copied; must match the other side's positive and avoid excludes — non-string exact values can't match an exclude, matching decide), keeps the legacy shortest-string path whenever no exclude participates, and only includes keys the pair declared, Unicode-sorted.
- Findings (`effect_overlap`, `shadowed_rule`) are emitted only when a replayable witness exists — even identical selectors that are unsatisfiable produce no finding — and witnesses are built once and shared by both branches.

**Snapshot**
- Non-empty `tag_exclude_patterns` exports in the fixed slot immediately after `tag_patterns`, keys recursively codepoint-sorted; empty maps are omitted so legacy `to_json` bytes and `fingerprint` are byte-identical, and roundtrip through `from_json` is lossless.

## Verification
- All 177 pre-existing tests pass unchanged; 21 new tests added (198 total) covering shapes/conflicts, decide/trace/batch/compare semantics, audit suppression, witness minimality/replay, byte-stable snapshots and roundtrip.
- Two throwaway randomized harnesses (deleted after use): 545 solver trials against an independent exhaustive `fnmatchcase` enumeration, and 800 end-to-end random rule pairs comparing audit findings and witnesses against brute-force enumeration — all agreed. Worst-case audit (100 adversarial rules) runs in ~0.1 s.
- README documents the new field. Tracked `.pyc` artifacts were restored so the diff is source-only (`README.md`, `app.py`, `tests/test_app.py`).
